companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: Placeholder Labs is a made-up company for the getmeajob demo. We build scheduling tools for clinics.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Build and maintain the Python APIs behind our booking app.

  • Write FastAPI services backed by Postgres
  • Ship small changes often and watch them in production

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• A minimum of 2 years of professional experience in backend development
  • Python and Postgres
  • Docker for local development
